items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: And then sometimes I had Art Blakey, you know, if he wasn't doin' nothin'.

ctx.x: I got Kalil. And then sometimes I had Art Blakey, you know, if he wasn't doin' nothin'. And then Jo Jones, old man Jo Jones. Yeah. Because Kalil started gettin' popular and he started, you know, takin' jobs. I didn't blame him for that, you know, because bein' at the Paradise everybody heard him. That was the spot, you know, so I didn't say nothin'.
What was the sequence of drummers?
